title: CLTR launches a Loss of Control Observatory for real-world scheming incidents
summary: The Centre for Long-Term Resilience announced the Loss of Control Observatory, a prototype that uses an OSINT-based methodology to detect and analyse real-world scheming and scheming-like incidents from transcripts of AI interactions reported online, with a focus on X, where API access covers up to 1 million posts monthly. Funded by the UK AI Security Institute's Challenge Fund, the project argues that existing incident databases rely on limited sources such as voluntary submissions or news stories, lack an explicit focus on scheming, and have feedback loops of days or weeks, and says CLTR has begun systematically collecting transcripts toward a first phase of a detection capability for monitoring trends.
